nodes.body: This adds another gating WCAG focus-indicator verdict even though the preceding theme loop already checks the same shared selector and backdrop. More importantly, `docs/accessibility.md:19-24,93,734-738` assigns focus visibility/appearance to a11y-scout and explicitly prohibits duplicate verdicts outside the owning layer. Keep the targeted Zoom-in selector/token contract test above, but remove this duplicate per-theme loop (or put the ticket mapping in the owning a11y-scout check).
